title: Contracts Senior Advisor (Renewable Energy)
description:
**What You Can Expect**

At ENGIE, we're building a cleaner, more resilient energy future. Every project delivered brings us closer to providing 100% decarbonized electricity for our customers. As part of that mission, you'll help shape the commercial agreements that enable utility\-scale renewable energy projects across solar, wind, battery storage, and related infrastructure.  



The Senior Contracts Advisor leads commercial contracting activities throughout the project lifecycle, negotiating EPC, supply, and service agreements ranging from several million to hundreds of millions of dollars. Working closely with teams across Development, Engineering, Construction, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Executive Management, you'll help structure agreements, manage risk, and support business decisions that advance project objectives.  



Serving as a trusted advisor and primary contracting partner to key business stakeholders, you'll influence complex negotiations, navigate competing priorities, and contribute to the successful delivery of renewable energy projects across ENGIE's growing portfolio.  


**What You’ll Do**
* Lead commercial contracting activities for utility\-scale renewable energy projects, including sourcing strategies, competitive solicitations, bid evaluations, vendor selection activities, and contract award recommendations
* Draft, review, negotiate, and administer a broad range of commercial agreements, including EPC, equipment supply, operations and maintenance, professional services, consulting, master service, confidentiality, change order, and other project\-related contracts
* Review commercial proposals, identify contractual deviations, and develop negotiation strategies that balance commercial objectives, project schedules, and risk considerations
* Lead negotiations with contractors, suppliers, consultants, and other counterparties while serving as a trusted advisor throughout the contracting lifecycle

title: Factory Acceptance Testing Process Engineer, Ford Energy
description:
**Overview**
------------


At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.


* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

  
**Ford Energy** is a newly formed, wholly\-owned subsidiary of Ford Motor Company dedicated to accelerating U.S. energy independence. Leveraging Ford’s century of manufacturing excellence and world\-class battery energy storage systems (BESS) technology, Ford Energy designs, manufactures, and services grid\-scale and commercial DC battery energy storage systems (BESS). Ford Energy is uniquely positioned to capture the growing demand for reliable, US\-built energy storage systems. We are not just building batteries; we are building the infrastructure for the next generation of the American grid.  

  



Why Ford Energy?
  

At Ford Energy, you have the backing of an industrial manufacturing powerhouse with the agility of a dedicated energy startup offering industry leading technology. We offer a competitive compensation package including performance\-based bonuses, Ford vehicle discounts, and the opportunity to shape the energy strategy of one of the world's most iconic brands. Learn more at https://fordenergy.com.  

  



In this position...
  

The FAT Process Engineer owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of End\-of\-Line (EOL) and Factory Acceptance Testing processes — the last line of defense ensuring every production unit meets requirements before it ships to a customer site. This role sits at the critical junction between design intent and manufacturing reality, translating validated requirements into repeatable, scalable production test processes, while also serving as a key technical contact during customer\-witnessed testing events that directly impact project timelines and customer confidence.

title: Project Manager
description:
Description:  



The **Project Manager** owns the successful execution of assigned customer projects from contract award through closeout, managing scope, schedule, budget, documentation, resources, and customer communications. As the primary point of coordination between customers and internal departments (Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Procurement, Planning, Shipping \& Receiving, and Leadership), this role drives project performance, mitigates risk, and ensures deliverables meet customer requirements.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 3\+ years of project management experience in manufacturing, industrial, energy, or related environments
* Experience managing customer\-driven projects with technical and contractual requirements
* Strong skills in project planning, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, and customer communication
* Ability to interpret contracts, specifications, drawings, and technical documentation
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and solve complex problems
* Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred; PMP certification a plus
* Experience with ERP systems, project scheduling tools, and Microsoft Office

### **Why Join Us?**

* Lead impactful projects from start to finish
* Work directly with customers and senior leadership
* Collaborate with talented cross\-functional teams
* Play a key role in delivering critical manufacturing solutions
* Opportunity to grow your career in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment


Requirements:
* Requires the ability to work in both office and manufacturing environments, including standing, walking, bending, reaching, and periodically lifting or moving materials in support of project management activities, inspections, and customer visits.

title: Permitting Project Manager-1
description:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US\-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.
  

  

AES has been **ranked \#1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.**
  

  

We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.


Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven\-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty\-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry.  

  

If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

  

The Permitting Project Manager leads permitting and environmental development activities for projects across the MISO, SPP, and ERCOT regions. This role supports renewable energy, powered land, natural gas generation, data center, and related energy infrastructure projects from early\-stage site screening through permit acquisition, construction handoff, and ongoing execution support. Working at the intersection of project development, environmental stewardship, and infrastructure delivery, this role offers the opportunity to help shape critical energy projects that support a more reliable and sustainable energy future.

* Collaborate with the Global Markets team to support the voice of customer and identification of customer needs.
* Foster and strengthen executive customer relationships and government, regulatory and public/media interfaces.
